identity_policy: name is the sound-request name (NAME/REQD); wave is the verified WAVE index; layers is the FULL set of waves in the sound, including the primary (layers[0] == wave). confidence is identity confidence only; 0x21 fidelity is a separate field and is medium for every row. ghidra rows require reqd+tone and must pass the actual SEQD/PLAY_TONE walk; audition rows require verified_index=true and are explicitly not chain-proven.

cues.name: boss01_vo_atk1
cues.chain: NAME hash -> REQD 340 -> SEQD 0x10B1. The per-sound bytecode at 0x6ABC is a parameter envelope (a9 SET_PARAM) whose PLAY_TONE operands are complex/random (a4 02 03 ...), so no fixed tone can be walked. Audition pick: wave 3 (1.202 s vocal).
cues.note: Not chain-verified. The 0x42 pair 108/109 is a large roar alternative.

cues.name: boss01_atk_hit_ground1
cues.chain: NAME hash(boss01_atk_hit_ground1) -> REQD 303 -> SEQD timeline 0x13E4 -> bytecode 0x23BA -> a4 01 43 -> TONE[43] = (key 57, wave 26); the sequence then plays tones 44-47 -> waves 27-30
cues.note: Layered sound: layers is the full set 26-30 including the primary. wave_pool_label is the pool string at index 26, not the request name. Identity high; 0x21 fidelity medium.
